verses.t: When the sky has split [open]
verses.pickthall: When the heaven is split asunder
verses.yusufAli: When the sky is rent asunder
verses.rodwell: WHEN the Heaven shall have SPLIT ASUNDER
verses.sale: When the heaven shall be rent in sunder

verses.t: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear
verses.yusufAli: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so)
verses.rodwell: And duteously obeyed its Lord
verses.sale: and shall obey its Lord, and shall be capable thereof

verses.t: And when the earth has been extended
verses.pickthall: And when the earth is spread out
verses.yusufAli: And when the earth is flattened out
verses.rodwell: And when Earth shall have been stretched out as a plain
verses.sale: and when the earth shall be stretched out

verses.t: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.pickthall: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
verses.yusufAli: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty
verses.rodwell: And shall have cast forth what was in her and become empty
verses.sale: and shall cast forth that which is therein, and shall remain empty

verses.t: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear
verses.yusufAli: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality)
verses.rodwell: And duteously obeyed its Lord
verses.sale: and shall obey its Lord, and shall be capable thereof

verses.t: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
verses.pickthall: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence)
verses.yusufAli: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him
verses.rodwell: Then verily, O man, who desirest to reach thy Lord, shalt thou meet him
verses.sale: O man, verily labouring thou labourest to meet thy Lord, and thou shalt meet Him

verses.t: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
verses.pickthall: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
verses.yusufAli: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand
verses.rodwell: And he into whose right hand his Book shall be given
verses.sale: And he who shall have his book given into his right hand

verses.t: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.pickthall: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
verses.yusufAli: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning
verses.rodwell: Shall be reckoned with in an easy reckoning
verses.sale: shall be called to an easy account

verses.t: And return to his people in happiness
verses.pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy
verses.yusufAli: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing
verses.rodwell: And shall turn, rejoicing, to his kindred
verses.sale: and shall turn unto his family with joy

verses.t: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
verses.pickthall: But whoso is given his account behind his back
verses.yusufAli: But he who is given his Record behind his back
verses.rodwell: But he whose Book shall be given him behind his back
verses.sale: But he who shall have his book given him behind his back

verses.t: He will cry out for destruction
verses.pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction
verses.yusufAli: Soon will he cry for perdition
verses.rodwell: Shall invoke destruction
verses.sale: shall invoke destruction to fall upon him

verses.t: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
verses.pickthall: And be thrown to scorching fire
verses.yusufAli: And he will enter a Blazing Fire
verses.rodwell: But in the fire shall he burn
verses.sale: and he shall be sent into hell to be burned

verses.t: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
verses.pickthall: He verily lived joyous with his folk
verses.yusufAli: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing
verses.rodwell: For that he lived joyously among his kindred
verses.sale: because he rejoiced insolently amidst his family on earth

verses.t: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)
verses.yusufAli: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)
verses.rodwell: Without a thought that he should return to God
verses.sale: Verily he thought that he should never return unto God

verses.t: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
verses.pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him
verses.yusufAli: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him
verses.rodwell: Yea, but his Lord beheld him
verses.sale: Yea verily; but his Lord beheld him

verses.t: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset
verses.yusufAli: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset
verses.rodwell: It needs not therefore that I swear by the sunset redness
verses.sale: Wherefore I swear by the redness of the sky after sun-set

verses.t: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth
verses.yusufAli: The Night and its Homing
verses.rodwell: And by the night and its gatherings
verses.sale: and by the night, and the animals which it driveth together

verses.t: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full
verses.yusufAli: And the Moon in her fullness
verses.rodwell: And by the moon when at her full
verses.sale: and by the moon when she is at the full

verses.t: [That] you will surely experience state after state
verses.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane
verses.yusufAli: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage
verses.rodwell: That from state to state shall ye be surely carried onward
verses.sale: ye shall surely be transferred successively from state to state

verses.t: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
verses.pickthall: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
verses.yusufAli: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not
verses.rodwell: What then hath come to them that they believe not
verses.sale: What aileth them, therefore, that they believe not the resurrection

verses.t: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
verses.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)
verses.yusufAli: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate
verses.rodwell: And that when the Koran is recited to them they adore not
verses.sale: and that, when the Koran is read unto them, they worship not

verses.t: But those who have disbelieved deny
verses.pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny
verses.yusufAli: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it)
verses.rodwell: Yea, the unbelievers treat it as a lie
verses.sale: Yea: The unbelievers accuse the same of imposture

verses.t: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
verses.pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding
verses.yusufAli: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
verses.rodwell: But God knoweth their secret hatreds
verses.sale: But God well knoweth the malice which they keep hidden in their breasts

verses.t: So give them tidings of a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: So give them tidings of a painful doom
verses.yusufAli: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous
verses.rodwell: Let their only tidings be those of painful punishment
verses.sale: Wherefore denounce unto them a grievous punishment

verses.t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
verses.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing
verses.yusufAli: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail
verses.rodwell: Save to those who believe and do the things that be right. An unfailing recompense shall be theirs
verses.sale: except those who believe and do good works: For them is prepared a never failing reward
